arguments.text: Stage 1 implementation and checks: work.py evaluates from>to via policy.edges; absent keys return blocked; edge role mismatch returns permission before retry validation; truthy retry requires attempts to be an int but not bool and 0 <= attempts < integer non-bool retry_limit; success returns requested to. report.json equals evaluation of both current requests. Independent probes covered missing edge, role-vs-retry precedence, attempts 0/1/2/-1/bool/float/missing, retry false, and deep-copy input immutability; all passed. Current fixtures do not establish behavior for malformed non-object inputs/edges or non-boolean retry markers.
